projection.what_this_does_NOT_check: It does not compare the LIVE rows' NUMBERS against their objects. A row left LIVE may still be stale by value. And the UNMAPPED rows have no object at all -- they are uncheckable, never clean, and they are why any count here is a FLOOR.
